name: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan 2027 (Earth)
short_description: Takbo Para sa Kalikasan's Earth Run is on Saturday 23 January 2027 at Quirino Grandstand, Manila, with a 25 km race plus 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km run with your dog.
ai_summary: The Earth leg of Takbo Para sa Kalikasan, an environment-themed run series by Green Media Events, is on Saturday 23 January 2027 at Quirino Grandstand in Manila, with the start listed at 4:00 am. Its longest race is 25 km, alongside 10 km, 5 km and a 1 km duo run with a dog. Fees range from PHP 1,395 to PHP 1,750 depending on distance and entry period.

faqs.question: When is the Takbo Para sa Kalikasan Earth Run?
faqs.answer: It is on Saturday 23 January 2027, with the start listed at 4:00 am Philippine time. The entry page still carries the name Earth Run 2026 because the series runs across the 2026 season, but the race date itself falls in January 2027, after the Air leg held in September 2026.

faqs.question: What distances can I run?
faqs.answer: The longest race is 25 km, a little beyond a half marathon. There are also 10 km and 5 km races and a 1 km duo run for an owner and dog. Regular fees are PHP 1,750 for 25 km, PHP 1,650 for 10 km and PHP 1,550 for the 5 km.

faqs.question: Where does the race start?
faqs.answer: The race is based at Quirino Grandstand in Rizal Park, Ermita, on Manila's bayfront, a regular start area for big city runs. The organiser, Green Media Events, has not yet published the 25 km course map or cut-off times on the MyRunTime entry page.
